verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet operations and teleoperation platform. A buyer comparing robotics platforms could reasonably ask about sim-to-real code portability, so the axis applies. The evidence covers agent installation, telemetry ingestion, commands, teleoperation and analytics, but nothing documents a simulation backend or running the same robot code in sim and on hardware. Adjacent items such as Docker/ROS agent installs and editing ROS_MASTER_URI earn no credit for this story.
